source.map_area_convention: [left,top,right,bottom], right/bottom exclusive; original icon-image pixels, x right, y down
source.geometry_convention: Clockwise y-down polygons, not repeated closed vertex; simplified visible roof/main-structure footprints; heights above local ground/platform
source.rotation_convention: Pad rotation_deg: clockwise from +x to first polygon edge, modulo 180; a drawing reference, not a pad class or in-game heading

scale.how: One shared X/Y scale for the whole source image, fitted by least squares in metres to the listed independent visible pad-side controls; uniform fallback when directional scales are not identifiable or would require excessive stretch.

limitations: A confirmed class does not identify a precise mechanical deck boundary: traced paint/apron envelopes are approximate.

fingerprint.description: One pad sits below a linked HAB and PWR, with a large IND building to the east and a southern yard of paired tanks and utility structures.

buildings.label: HAB
buildings.notes: Single main HAB roof and horizontal connector toward PWR. Side image shows a low single-level volume; height is approximate.

buildings.label: PWR
buildings.notes: PWR rectangular roof and round machinery envelope. Roof body estimate is separate from the elevated machinery cap.

buildings.label: IND
buildings.notes: IND main body, attached western low roof under the paired chimneys, and lower southern wing. The western roof is confirmed by the Side view and the pale enclosing wall/roof strips in Satellite; its dark surface is part of the fixed factory, not merely a shadow gap. The small lower entry projection remains separate along the shared western edge. Side shows a raised main mass over a lower frontage; two floors remain a low-confidence estimate with a one-tall-bay alternative.

Small low industrial entry/service projection west of the attached main IND wing. Its eastern edge at x1058 shares the main-roof boundary, avoiding duplicate roof area; the fixed western factory roof under the chimneys is included in ind and confirmed in Side. Surrounding cast shadows remain excluded.
Small detached fixed utility hut east of PWR, confirmed as a low enclosure in side view.
Small unlabelled southern utility enclosure. Tan surrounding paved platform is a separate detail.
Low southern service building with end bays, linked to the isolated lime terminal annotation.
Large fixed low machinery/tank installation in the southern yard. Height is visual; this is not assumed to contain an occupied storey.
Large fixed low machinery/tank installation in the southern yard. Height is visual; this is not assumed to contain an occupied storey.

notes: Icon coordinates are printed annotation centres, not surveyed physical feature locations; all physical point floors remain null.

The HAB-to-PWR connecting roof belongs to the HAB outline for indexing; the two roofs share a complex. The small IND entry projection is separately outlined along the main factory western edge, while the attached western roof under the chimney pair is confirmed in Side and included in the main IND envelope.
Small unlabelled fixed structures are recorded as other rather than assigned an unsupported function. Roof hardware has shape-only details and separate height notes where useful.
Orange website information control, craft, hovering vehicles, people, rocks and shadows are excluded from the data.
uncertain: Heights and floors are low-confidence visual estimates from the side reference and apparent door/storey proportions, without a metre scale.
The large IND building has a main occupied volume and a raised central roof; two storeys are plausible, but one tall industrial bay is also possible.
Ground walls beneath roof eaves and obscured structures behind tall tanks/stack shadows cannot be recovered precisely.
The terminal at the HAB/PWR junction is assigned to HAB for indexing; its precise room attachment is unknown.
Tiny dark dots that could be people, terrain or shadows are not invented as fixed light posts; visible containers, structures and tank connections are individually outlined.

construction.verification: Every live Approximate Shopping List was opened and its commodity IDs/quantities captured. Sorted commodity-pair FNV-1a digest and quantity sum were independently checked against this saved record. Values are approximate, not a guaranteed project bill.

distinctive_geometry_features: Single small pad in front of the main complex.
Eight round ground tanks in two rows of four beside the pad.
HAB and PWR joined near one corner, with a separate twin-chimney factory and low cargo/service yard on the other side.

calibration.method: One shared X/Y scale for the whole source image, fitted by least squares in metres to the listed independent visible pad-side controls; uniform fallback when directional scales are not identifiable or would require excessive stretch.

limitations: A confirmed class does not identify a precise mechanical deck boundary: traced paint/apron envelopes are approximate.

Colonisation.metric_height_policy: Prior roof/storey/equipment height estimates are retained, with their original confidence/basis. The revised pad-based registration updates horizontal metres and visible footprint dimensions.

previous_scale.how: Pad target and matched template feature registration in independently established metre coordinates.
previous_scale.basis: Visually matched SrvSurvey telemetry-based metric layout: verified pad classes/positions with roof or physical-feature checks. Physical S/M/L pad deck dimensions are not treated as officially specified.
previous_scale.limitations: Approximate uniform horizontal scale; camera perspective, terrain, roof parallax and cropped/obscured landing targets limit accuracy. Range is a practical judgement, not a statistical confidence interval.

previous_calibration.range_note: Deliberate practical uncertainty envelope for template/control placement and perspective; not a confidence interval and not derived from assumed pad dimensions.

geometry_m.coordinate_precision_note: Four decimals support reproducible drawing and do not imply millimetre physical accuracy.

geometry_m.superseded_note: Kept for traceability. site_m holds the plan fitted to SrvSurvey's measured positions, in SrvSurvey's site frame.

frame.origin: Settlement position from the journal (ApproachSettlement Latitude/Longitude), as SrvSurvey uses it
frame.heading: Site heading = ship heading while docked on pad 1, or ship heading minus that pad's rotation_deg on any other pad (SrvSurvey HumanSiteData).
frame.to_world: bearing = heading + atan2(x, y); east = x*cos(h) + y*sin(h); north = -x*sin(h) + y*cos(h)
frame.rotation_convention: rotation_deg and rot_deg are clockwise from +y
frame.floor_convention: SrvSurvey floors: 1 = ground floor, 2 = one floor up, 3 = two floors up. SrvSurvey also uses 0: on every combat-zone point and on a few others, where its meaning isn't documented; those are copied as given. floor_basis says where each floor came from: srvsurvey, or icon carets (the plan's ^ marks, no caret = ground floor). plan_floor keeps the plan's reading where SrvSurvey's differs.
frame.access_convention: Security level 0-3: SrvSurvey's level where matched, otherwise the plan's printed number
frame.source_convention: plan = only on the plan; srvsurvey = only in SrvSurvey; plan+srvsurvey = both, at SrvSurvey's position

site_m.pixel_to_site_note: [X, Y, W] = M . [px, py, 1]; site = (X/W, Y/W). Third row is [0, 0, 1] for a uniform fit.
